## `/fundadmin:fund multi-doc-analyze <files>` {#multi-doc-analyze}

Multi-document cross-reference analysis

Cross-references 2+ related fund documents for provision conflicts, amendment lineage, and MFN cascades. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund multi-doc-analyze`, asks how an LPA, side letters, and amendments interact, or shares several fund documents together.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund multi-doc-analyze <files>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-multi-doc-analyze <files>` |
| Codex | `$fund-multi-doc-analyze <files>` |

**Writes** `MULTI-DOC-ANALYSIS-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-multi-doc-analyze/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund smart-contract-sim <file>` {#smart-contract-sim}

Waterfall simulation & scenario calculator

Runs the packaged whole-fund waterfall helper on user-supplied scenarios: tier traces, edge cases and pseudocode; clawback and deal-by-deal stay UNCALCULATED. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund smart-contract-sim`, asks how a waterfall would execute, or shares LPA waterfall terms.

|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund smart-contract-sim <file>` |

## `/fundadmin:fund chat` {#chat}

Conversational fund administration query

Conversational query interface over fund documents and prior `/fund` outputs, answering with document, section, and exact-quote citations and routing to the command that fills a data gap. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund chat` or asks ad hoc questions about their fund documents. Answers inline.

## `/fundadmin:fund amendment-draft <file>` {#amendment-draft}

LPA amendment drafting (side letters: draft-side-letter)

Drafts a formatted LPA amendment with recitals, amendment clauses, ratification, signature blocks, and a redline of old versus new text. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund amendment-draft`, asks to amend an LPA, or shares an LPA with the changes wanted.
